review.notes: Full review of the head. Previous review had no finding to check. Whole README read; the new section 11.9 read against LTXZZ Appendix D.1 (published text, pp. 365-368); 48 source locators checked (CS17 34, LTXZZ 8, Shin09 3, Shin-BCU 2, Shin12 1), covering the fifteen sampled targets. Supplier sections read on main or at the open head: AutomorphicGaloisRepresentationsPartII AG2.2 and AG2.7, EndoscopicTransferAndUnitaryTraceComparison 6.3, 6.25, 8.21, 13.1, PELModuli M0.2, M0.6, M0.8, M2.8, M4.8, M4.9, the parent's 0.11, 1.3, 3.17, 4.4, 4.5, 5.1, 7.2, 7.14. Automatic checks: all passed; dependency check 0 problems, no UPWARD or CYCLE; nothing outside the folder. Suggested.lean elaborates with two sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe closes neither theorem. One finding (P2): for a CM field without an imaginary quadratic subfield, the Galois representation and local-global comparison used by the route of 11.9 are supplied by nobody (AG2.2 and the declared gap are stated for F = F+K only). Four small corrections (description omits 11.9 and the fourth gap; the fourth gap is compound and attached to two different sections; a route sentence claims Frobenius polynomials at places the trace identity does not reach; the Lean docstring does not name the 11.9 headline) and one format note. The three declared gaps were not raised; the fourth gap is in the README only and is reported to the human reviewers.
